title: Bug Case Study: Unsafe Asynchronous HSEL Consumption
description: HSEL is a combinational address decode and can transition within a cycle; only the value sampled on a rising HCLK edge with HREADY HIGH identifies the accepted slave.

annotations.message: Slave 1 is selected for accepted address 0x10.
The decoder settles on Slave 3 for 0x30. A transient raw S2 pulse between clock edges is not an accepted S2 transfer because HSEL_S2 is sampled LOW at the accepting edge.
Slave 3 remains selected for the continuing SEQ address 0x34.

violations.message: INTEGRATION BUG: An asynchronous latch or clock gate reacts to the raw S2 pulse. Protocol-facing state must use the HSEL value sampled with HREADY HIGH, which is 0 for S2.
